findings.description: Hazel's fingers slightly clip through the rope fibers while touching Krethon's knot.
findings.fix: Clean up the contact area between fingers and rope geometry.

findings.description: The pulley rope carrying the basket clips slightly through stone wall geometry as it rises.
findings.fix: Adjust rope spline offset away from the stone wall edges.

findings.description: Incoming flaming arrows produce heavy, rocket-like smoke exhaust trails across the sky.
findings.fix: Replace thick rocket propellant smoke trails with subtle ballistic fire particle arcs.
findings.refined_description: At around 01:31-01:34, an incoming flaming projectile in the sky leaves behind a thick, continuous gray smoke contrail that mimics the exhaust trajectory of a modern rocket rather than a standard flaming arrow.

summary: Character identity and performance consistency remain solid across all scenes. Minor physics clipping occurs during hand-prop interactions and basket ascent. Visual effects for fire projectiles appear slightly anachronistic due to heavy smoke plumes.
